name: hud_scoreboard_dispatch_set_scale
description: HudScoreboard::DispatchSetScale forwards a delta-time scale value through the HUD stats-list element update ftable slot.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred; no VC target currently covers 0x40eae0.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40eae0 validates loading g_HudUiMgrStatsList, pushing deltaTime, loading its base ftable, and dispatching slot 9 at offset 0x24.
Native smoke zhud_scoreboard_dispatch_set_scale_smoke installs a test stats-list ftable slot and verifies DispatchSetScale forwards the receiver and exact deltaTime.
